profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Github: https://github.com/Knguyen21

As a full-stack web developer with a background in psychology and research, I am fascinated by the creativity, critical thinking, and problem solving involved in software development. I have never felt more driven and excited then when I am using my creativity to design and develop web applications.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer Consultant
positions.description:
Primarily worked at Moderna (August 2016 - December 2018)
Moderna is a biotech company focused on drug discovery and drug development based on mRNA.
- Managed large data with Sequelize and PostgreSQL
- Developed and designed full stack web applications using Angular, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, HTML/CSS, and Less
- Collaborated and communicated with clinical directors, project managers, and research team to create internal applications, update features for them, and solve queries.
 - Developed app for researchers to design nucleotide sequences with interactive dropping and dragging blocks
- Utilized Angular gantt-chart to track early stage project activities and integrate app with other internal apps
- Visualized clinical data using Angular and D3.js
- Designed and implemented internal email service for clinical research data queries using JavaScript, Node.js and Express
- Added feature to upload files to AWS S3 and download data to excel sheet
- Developed app to visualize stability studies’ samples’ pull date schedule and test results from 3rd party API
- Designed and created clinical development planning app to track project risks with version control
-Refactored legacy code using best practices.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive Apprentice
positions.description:
- Created and deployed full stack web applications using JavaScript, Ruby, Ember.js, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Express.js,MongoDB, Mongoose, Bootstrap, handlebars, 
- Wrote user stories and wire frames for full stack web applications
- Kept track of my work flow by utilizing Git frequently.

positions.title: Introduction to Computer Science - Python (audited)
positions.description:
I audit an Introduction to Computer Science course at University of Massachusetts Boston and received an A.
During the course: 
•	wrote several programs that take in a JPEG image file and apply various photographic filters, e.g., greyscale, blur, negative, solarize, flip, and threshold, to the file. Techniques: conditional statements, for-loops
•	created a program and made a data type to generate stylized pseudo-random text.  In addition, I implemented a method in the data type to decode noisy messages and wrote a client program to print out the most likely original string of the noisy message. Techniques: classes, objects, methods, dictionaries, data-driven applications
•	Provided with ten datasets containing a sequence of two hundred JPEG images of beads suspended in water and undergoing Brownian motion, I wrote a program using depth-first search to identify the beads, analyze the data, determine the radial distance that each beads moves from one frame to the next, and compute an estimate of Avogadro’s number. Techniques: depth-first search, object identification, file manipulation, numerical computing

positions.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II - Radiation Oncology
positions.description:
•	Managed data collection via Excel and online database
•	Monitored and reported adverse events as required by institutional/federal regulations
•	Prepared submission of protocol revisions to the IRB
•	Verified patient eligibility via chart abstraction and clinical analysis of case data
•	Scheduled protocol required medical evaluations for study patients

positions.title: Bulfinch Temp Clinical Research Assistant II - Cardiology
positions.description:
•	Recruited, enrolled, and consented subjects 
•	Screened subjects for study using online medical records: CAS and OnCall
•	Corresponded with doctors and subjects regarding study enrollment
•	Processed data using Microsoft Excel 
•	Transported  biological samples

positions.title: Research Assistant - Categorization and Reasoning Laboratory
positions.description:
•	Assisted in experimental design and protocol writing
•	Prepared Cedrus Superlab stimuli presentation software and Audacity audio production suite
•	Scored children’s and adults’ open ended responses

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
•	Planned recreational activities
•	Supervised children and infants

positions.title: Clinical Research Assistant II - Freedom Trail Clinic
positions.description:
•	Performed clinical assessments: Vital signs; Novel Antipsychotic Medication Experience Scale
•	Organized and managed clinical records of patients 
•	Transported biological samples

positions.title: Research Assistant- Professor Destano's Laboratory (Social Psychology Lab)
positions.description:
•	Scored visual data on group interactions
•	Scored subjects’ handwritten open ended responses
•	Evaluated and rated videos of the participants interaction in groups

projects.title: Taste-or-Waste
projects.description:
Food inventory app for users to track of their food items and display how they dispose of the items.
JavaScript, Ember.js, Rails, Bootstrap, HTML/CSS

projects.title: Take A'Vey
projects.description:
Survey app that allows users to create custom surveys, answer survey questions, and view the results.
JavaScript, JQuery, MongoDB/Mongoose, Node.js, Express.js, SCSS, HTML, Handlebars, Bootstrap
